summary: Frontend-only testing of the new 'Mohammed' assistant in 'Il Tuo Laboratorio' (mobile 390x844, preview URL). Flow verified end-to-end: intro guide dismissal, admin login (admin@mikilab.de), PRO paywall passed, lab tab. Mohammed intro card renders at the TOP of the wizard (assistant y=225 vs maestro-stepper y=475) with avatar image loading correctly (1024x1024, /mohammed-avatar.jpg) and heading 'Ciao, sono Mohammed'. Chat toggle opens mohammed-chat with 3 suggestion chips; both chip-click and input+send flows stream replies via POST /api/mohammed/chat. IN-SCOPE question ('Come imposto la cottura nel forno?') returned practical numbered/bulleted Italian baker guidance referencing app tools (Termostato & Sensori, HACCP). OUT-OF-SCOPE ('Che tempo fa domani?') returned the refusal string EXACTLY as specified (byte-for-byte match after whitespace normalisation). EN language switch works: card copy switches to English and reply came back in English while keeping persona/scope. Markdown renders (13 <li>, 14 <strong>), send button correctly disabled while busy, loader shown before first delta. No console errors during chat (only two pre-login 401s from auth/me, expected).

ui_bugs.issue: Auto-scroll bug: endRef.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'}) scrolls the WHOLE page (not just the inner chat container). After sending a message the chat panel ends up completely above the viewport (measured bounding box y = -299 with window.scrollY = 746 on 390x844), so the user does not see Mohammed's streamed reply unless they manually scroll back up. Reply content itself is correct when scrolled into view.

Floating 'Radio' (left) and 'Parla' (right) circular buttons overlay the bottom-left/right corners of the Mohammed chat panel and the wizard's Indietro/Avanti buttons on mobile, partially covering text/controls.

issues: Chat panel max-h-72 combined with the page-level auto-scroll makes long replies hard to follow
FAB overlap over wizard nav buttons

action_items: Fix Mohammed chat auto-scroll: scroll only the inner messages container (e.g. container.scrollTop = container.scrollHeight, or scrollIntoView({block:'nearest'})) so the page doesn't jump the chat out of the viewport during streaming.
Raise z-index / reposition of the Radio & Parla FABs so they don't overlap the chat panel and wizard nav buttons on mobile.
critical_code_review_comments: MohammedAssistant.send(): `res.body.getReader()` is used without checking res.ok — a non-200 (e.g. 402 paywall, 500) yields an empty assistant bubble or generic catch message; check res.ok and surface an error state.
No abort handling: switching tabs/unmounting during streaming leaves the fetch running and setState on unmounted component; consider AbortController.
GET /api/mohammed/history/{session_id} is never consumed by the UI — chat history is lost on remount even though the session id persists in localStorage.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (6/6 functional checks pass, 1 HIGH scroll UX bug)

seed_data_creation: Created chat_messages under session ids mohammed-* (test chats). Not cleaned up; safe to drop sessions starting with 'mohammed-'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Access recipe: set localStorage mikilab_onboarding={"done":true} + reload, then dismiss IntroGuide via [data-testid=intro-close-btn] (this modal is separate from Onboarding and blocks all clicks), then login-btn -> auth-email/auth-password/auth-submit, then nav-tab-maestro. Mohammed streaming takes ~10-20s for a full reply; poll inner_text of [data-testid=mohammed-chat]. Remember the page auto-scrolls away — use window.scrollTo(0,0) before screenshots.
rca_of_the_issue: Scroll bug root cause: the useEffect calls endRef.current.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'}) on every messages change; because the sentinel is inside an overflow-y-auto container that is itself inside the normally-scrolling document, the browser scrolls the nearest scrollable ancestor AND the document, pushing the whole assistant card above the viewport.
